definitions.gloss: full repayment; paying off a debt completely
definitions.explanation: The act of finishing payment on a loan, debt, or other financial obligation. Means paying the entire amount owed, with nothing remaining.

examples.japanese: ローンを{完済|かんさい}した。
{住宅|じゅうたく}ローンの{完済|かんさい}まであと{五年|ごねん}かかる。
examples.english: It will take five more years to pay off the mortgage.

examples.japanese: {借金|しゃっきん}を{完済|かんさい}して、やっと{肩|かた}の{荷|に}が{下|お}りた。
examples.english: After paying off all my debts, I finally felt a weight lifted from my shoulders.

notes:
{完済|かんさい} means paying off a debt or loan completely, with nothing remaining.

FORMS:
{完|かん} (complete) + {済|さい} (settle, finish)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ローンを{完済|かんさい}する: to pay off a loan
- {借金|しゃっきん}を{完済|かんさい}する: to pay off a debt
- {完済|かんさい}{証明書|しょうめいしょ}: certificate of full repayment
- {完済|かんさい}{日|び}: date of final payment

RELATED FINANCIAL TERMS:
- {返済|へんさい}: repayment (not necessarily complete)
- {未済|みさい}: unpaid, outstanding
- {繰|く}り{上|あ}げ{返済|へんさい}: early repayment

WATCH OUT:
{関西|かんさい} (Kansai region) — completely different kanji and meaning.

REGISTER:
Formal/financial. Commonly appears in banking and legal contexts.
